bind_interfaces_only.description: If enabled, the server will only listen on the interfaces specified in the 'interfaces' parameter.

deadtime.description: Number of minutes after a client has no open files to disconnect them. 0 means never.

guest_account.description: The account name to use for guest logins.

interfaces.description: List of interfaces to bind to. Empty means all.

ipc_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for IPC connections. 0 means never.

kerberos_keytab_file.description: Path to the Kerberos keytab file.

map_to_guest.description: Mapping of unknown users to guest account. Options: never, bad user, auto.

max_active_sessions.description: Maximum number of active sessions allowed.

server_signing.description: Server signing policy. Options: disabled, enabled, enforced.

server_string.description: Server string displayed in network listings.

smb2_max_read.description: Maximum read size for SMB2. Use suffix K, M, G.

smb2_max_trans.description: Maximum transaction size for SMB2. Use suffix K, M, G.

smb2_max_write.description: Maximum write size for SMB2. Use suffix K, M, G.

smb3_encryption.description: SMB3 encryption policy. Options: auto, off, on.

smbd_max_io_size.description: Maximum I/O size for smbd. Use suffix K, M, G.

create_mask.description: Default permission mask for newly created files in shares.

directory_mask.description: Default permission mask for newly created directories in shares.

force_create_mode.description: Force create mode for files. 0000 means no forcing.

force_directory_mode.description: Force create mode for directories. 0000 means no forcing.

force_group.description: Force group ownership for new files. Empty means no forcing.

force_user.description: Force user ownership for new files. Empty means no forcing.

hide_dot_files.description: Hide dot files (starting with .) by default.

inherit_owner.description: Inherit owner from parent directory by default.

invalid_users.description: Comma-separated list of users who are not allowed to log in. Empty means no restriction.

path.description: Default path for shares. Empty means no default.

read_list.description: Comma-separated list of users/groups allowed to read. Empty means default behavior.

read_only.description: Default read-only status for shares. Can be 'yes' or 'no'.

store_dos_attributes.description: Store DOS attributes for files by default.

valid_users.description: Comma-separated list of valid users. Empty means all valid system users.

veto_files.description: Comma-separated list of file patterns to veto (hide). Empty means no veto.

vfs_objects.description: List of VFS objects to load. Empty means none.

write_list.description: Comma-separated list of users/groups allowed to write. Empty means default behavior.
